subject: metering round trip on A04E
verdict: UNVERIFIED — not measurable from the available vantage, and not measurable at all on this box as configured

findings.meaning: nodogsplash tracks no clients, so there is nothing to meter
the managed interface has never seen this MAC

findings.fact: host IS a br-lan client: lease 50:76:af:2f:33:ed = 192.168.1.159
findings.meaning: it is associated, but its INTERNET traffic does not traverse br-lan

findings.fact: ip route get 1.1.1.1 -> dev enx00e04c36043e via 192.168.2.1
findings.meaning: egress bypasses A04E entirely (wired default route wins on metric), so no bytes are attributable to the managed interface

findings.fact: ndsctl auth aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:77 -> 'Failed to authenticate client'
findings.meaning: even a synthetic MAC cannot be registered, so the diagnostic cannot be forced either

what_is_proven: ndsctl has NO `state` command (the old code called it) — measured, and fixed in PR #40
the `json` shape is {"clients":{"<mac>":{"downloaded":N,"uploaded":M}}} — parser written to it and unit-tested
`{}` from ndsctl is absence, now an Err rather than a silent (0,0) — unit-tested
what_is_not_proven: that poll_usage returns a NON-ZERO reading for a client that really transferred bytes
that /usage therefore reflects reality end to end
how_to_close_it: put a client on br-lan (WiFi guest SSID) and route its DEFAULT through the gateway, then transfer traffic and read ndsctl json <mac>
or run the same measurement on a box whose gate is actually carrying client traffic
